prompts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: final 3x3 exercise-animation keyframe sheet, nine equal square cells in row-major chronological order, no gutters or text. Generate a NEW precise high-quality full-color realistic educational render of a muscular adult man performing a prone lying leg curl on a selectorized machine. Input 1 is a GEOMETRIC REFERENCE ONLY: follow its nine exact joint positions, constant bone lengths and locked apparatus placement; replace its stick figure with a finished realistic muscular human. Input 2 is the APPROVED CHARACTER, skin color, clothes and render-style reference only. Input 3 is old apparatus context and is NOT a valid anatomy reference; its lower-leg growth must be corrected.
Camera: strict orthographic SIDE PROFILE, looking horizontally at the man's left side. Man's head points RIGHT, feet LEFT. Absolutely no camera perspective, camera move, framing change or zoom across cells. Full apparatus and all shoes fit inside each cell with generous margin. Same tan muscular shirtless man, charcoal gym shorts, black sneakers with white soles, fixed warm off-white studio backdrop, consistent shadows and materials.
Critical kinematics: the hip, torso, head, upper arms, hands, BOTH thighs and BOTH knees remain in the identical image coordinates in ALL NINE CELLS. Chest and pelvis stay supported on the pad. The knees align with the machine's fixed pivot. The tibias are RIGID segments of the SAME screen-space length in every cell. Only the shins and attached rigid feet rotate smoothly upward around those FIXED knees: 0,12.5,25,37.5,50,62.5,75,87.5,100 degrees flexion. This is nine stages of ONE ascending motion, NOT repeated cycles. Neither shin nor calf nor shoe may lengthen, thicken, bulge or change scale as it rises. Keep femur, tibia, feet and torso true constant lengths; near/far legs parallel and similarly sized. Show muscular natural anatomy, not a skinny mannequin.
Machine: rigid stable gray steel bench/frame and fixed tower. One rigid lever pivots exactly at the knee; its radius never changes. A constant-diameter black padded roller follows the back of the lower shins just above the heels, staying at the same fixed distance from knee in every frame; roller cannot move independently or grow. Visible weight stack has a fixed block of EIGHT identical rectangular plates lifting as one intact block, exposing a growing gap beneath the block, not adding or stretching plates. Its dimensions/count NEVER change. Absolutely no bent steel, vanishing supports, moving bench, floor sliding or penetrating body/equipment. Use geometry reference to keep all invariants. No numbers, arrows, anatomy overlays, captions, logos or watermarks. Final sheet must be 3x3, exactly nine individually complete poses.

Use case: sketch-to-render, anatomical exercise animation source sheet.
EDIT INPUT IMAGE 1, the 3x3 geometric pose guide. Keep its STRICT SIDE PROFILE camera, exact joint centers, exact constant bone lengths, nine distinct pose angles, machine/bench frame positions and layout. Replace the schematic colored sticks with a finished REALISTIC MUSCULAR HUMAN and the gray line machine with a realistic gray steel gym machine. Input image 2 is ONLY the character's skin, clothes and muscle-rendering style. DO NOT copy image2's camera or machine. Do not use any previous prone-curl picture.
Nine equal square cells, 3x3 row-major, no gutters or numbers. Same tan shirtless muscular man with charcoal shorts and black shoes, lies prone HEAD RIGHT and FEET LEFT on fixed flat padded bench. STRICT PROFILE (no visible width perspective to torso/legs); left thigh and left shin full projected length. Upper body, thighs, hip, knees identical across ALL cells. Only the shins/feet rotate UP around the SAME KNEE POINT. Follow EXACT guide lengths: within each 418px cell, knee=(140,235), hip=(228,228), shoulder=(315,218). Shin knee-to-ankle length=86px in every pose, NEVER larger. Ankle positions across 9 cells: (54,235), (56,216), (62,199), (72,183), (85,169), (100,159), (118,152), (136,149), (155,150). Foot heel-to-toe length=25px constant, rigidly rotates with shin. Camera orthographic side-on makes all limb lengths invariant. DO NOT inflate calves, extend feet or lengthen the tibia at the top. Near and far leg overlap with only a small offset. Anatomical muscular contours remain realistic and constant in scale.
Keep bench horizontal fixed at y255 and its legs/base/tower stationary. One rigid lever rotates from the SAME knee-axis to the same spot above ankle, constant radius, gray metal NEVER bends or stretches. The black roller keeps constant size. Enclose the pulley in a fixed black opaque tower shroud, with a small window showing ONE BLOCK of EIGHT identical plates lifting as a rigid block with space below, never multiplying. Machine must remain proportional to human exactly as guide. Hands hold stationary front handles. Chest and hips stay on pad. Neck neutral. Full equipment visible with margins.
Same clean off-white background and fixed soft shading all nine poses. The main purpose is CORRECT CONSTANT ANATOMY in a frozen side-profile camera. Render art, no overlay skeleton, no labels, no watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT THIS EXISTING 3x3 PRONE LEG CURL KEYFRAME SHEET. Keep ALL existing athlete pixels/poses, anatomy, shorts, shoes, bench, frame, tower outline, floor, light, camera and layout unchanged. Correct ONLY the weight-stack windows inside the fixed vertical tower.
Currently there are two separate blocks of plates in each tower, an upper and lower block. This is wrong. There must be ONE selected stack of EIGHT equal rigid rectangular plates total per cell. Remove ALL plates in the LOWER tower window below the bench and replace that lower window with uniform opaque matte black fixed shroud (same in all9 cells, no plate outlines). The lower visible shroud stays dark and completely EMPTY.
In the UPPER tower window, show exactly ONE rigid block of EIGHT plates. All 8 plates are identical 33px wide x7px high with1px gap, total block height63px; dimensions and count unchanged across all9cells. The SAME rigid block must visibly RISE as legs curl up. Each418px cell: block left x247, rightx280. Its TOP Y coordinates in row-major frames1..9: 132,127,121,116,110,105,99,94,88. Its BOTTOM Y is alwaysTOP+63. Where naturally hidden by the supported torso/pad, preserve occlusion. Guide rails are fixed vertical, and a clear EMPTY dark gap beneath the upper block increases with every frame; never show a second block remaining below. No stretching, growing, multiplying or tilting plates. Tower, guide rails and bench NEVER move.
Everything outside these UPPER/LOWER window interiors must remain identical, especially every near/far shin, knee, calf, foot and roller position and muscular anatomy. The aim is a continuous animation of one real fixed-size weight block lifting while the man curls. No new labels, arrows, highlights, overlay, text or watermarks. Same exact nine poses and 3x3 grid.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached3x3 exercise keyframe sheet. Change ONLY the UPPER WEIGHT-STACK WINDOW interior in ALL NINE CELLS. Replace the visible metal plates and guide rails INSIDE THAT WINDOW with a plain smooth OPAQUE MATTE BLACK PROTECTIVE COVER, consistent with the existing black lower tower cover. This machine has a FULLY ENCLOSED WEIGHT STACK; no plates or guide rails visible anywhere. The cover is a single rigid rectangle identical in every frame. Preserve the gray outer tower/frame outline and its two top bolts. No windows, slots, numbers, cables or plates visible through the opaque cover.
Keep everything else PIXEL-IDENTICAL to this existing artwork: athlete's exact skin, muscles, limbs/poses, all nine shin/foot positions and sizes, shorts, bench, lever, roller, handgrips, machine frame/feet, floor, shadow, camera, layout and colors. Do not regenerate the man or bench, do not change joints or perspective. Only cover the UPPER window interiors uniformly black. Retain3x3 nine complete exercise poses. No text, arrows, outlines, overlay or watermark.

notes: Final machine has an opaque protective weight-stack shroud; no visible plate count/geometry to drift.
External roller/lever remains visible to demonstrate knee flexion.
